plugins.name: rstack
plugins.description: rstack is my personal stack: the rules I want every agent to follow when it writes, designs, reviews, and ships code with me. It includes an rstack-mode router with playbooks, code guidelines, testing, frontend design, code review, app architecture, backend, agent files, issue management, agent orchestration, council, and rstack-help and setup-rstack for onboarding.
